newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICAN TAX REVENUE UP ONLY FOUR PERCENT-REPORT.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICAN TAX REVENUE UP ONLY FOUR PERCENT-REPORT.

text.p: Tax revenue was up less than four percent for the first five months, way under the projected increase budgeted by the South African government's tax collection programme, Business Tonight television reported.

The budgeted increase for the full year was close to 14 percent, the report said. In the past, big revenue overruns have helped the government keep its deficit in check but this year it could be caught short.

Equisec economist David Rootdt said he was unsurprised by the low revenue collections. "I expecting a slowdown in revenue at the end or later on in the fiscal year, especially as the economy starts slowing down," he said.
